Read the three FFN rows that changed against r2026-11-08-ffn3-1-720p's same-build rows, since this build differs from it only in the three emitter arguments: ffn_ptx 4032x256 e8 r4 0.464, ffn_ptx 16128x128 e4 r4 +proj 0.313 and e4 r4 0.050, ffn_ptx 64512x64 e2 r4 +proj 0.159 and e2 r4 0.051, and the total (3.619) against profile-720p's 3.620. A cap change on a kernel that is 12.8% of the pass is worth a fraction of a millisecond, so a move inside 0.03 ms on a row is noise and the direction is the reading.
